categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land settlement matters, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than any government personnel or organizational matter.
